practice_areas: Appeals of Decisions of the New York State Office of Persons with Developmental Disabilities
firm_data.firm_description: Cuddy Law Firm, P.L.L.C. provides legal services to families of individuals with special needs. The firm represents families in advocacy, administrative proceedings and state and federal courts.
notable_facts: The firm began operating in 2001 as The Law Office of Andrew K. Cuddy.
In 2012, the firm incorporated and began operation as Cuddy Law Firm and opened an office in White Plains, New York.
The firm has offices in Auburn & Valhalla, NY, Cleveland, OH, Philadelphia, PA, and Charlotte Metro Area, NC.

email.subject: AI for Cuddy Law Firm, built for special education practices
email.body:
Hi Andrew,

Your firm has spent over two decades representing families in special education law and guardianship matters across multiple states. That kind of sustained focus on complex, high-stakes cases requires precision and deep client trust, especially when handling administrative proceedings and appeals.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Auburn area to meet with firms doing this caliber of work. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
